summary: Solaris Energy Infrastructure filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026 disclosing a Rule 144A/Reg S private placement of $1.25 billion 7.000% senior notes due 2032, upsized from $1.0 billion, through initial purchasers led by MUFG Securities Americas. Notes price at par, mature April 1, 2032, with net proceeds of roughly $1,227.2 million after discounts and expenses, expected to close October 1, 2026. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes and growth capex. This is a routine high-yield debt financing, not a special situation; watch leverage and rate risk rather than deal terms.
